working_definition: L2 is lamina monopolar neuron 2, a columnar interneuron with soma and dendrites in the lamina and an axon projecting to medulla layer M2. It receives histaminergic input from outer photoreceptors R1-R6 in the lamina, has both pre- and postsynaptic connections in M2 (receiving strong centrifugal input from C2 and C3, and sending strong output to L5, T1, Tm1, Tm2 and Tm4), and is a cholinergic neuron electrically coupled to L1. It is the principal interneuron of the OFF motion-detection pathway.

best_match.fbbt_definition: A lamina monopolar neuron with short collaterals that project radially from the main projection in the lamina and that arborizes in medulla layer M2. In the lamina it receives strong input from photoreceptors R1-R6 (Rivera-Alba et al., 2011). It has both pre- and postsynaptic connections in medulla layer M2, with strong synaptic input coming from centrifugal neurons C2 and C3 (Takemura et al., 2013). It has a large number of presynaptic connections to lamina monopolar neuron L5, columnar neuron T1, and transmedullary neurons Tm1, Tm2 and Tm4 (Takemura et al., 2013). It is a cholinergic neuron (Takemura et al., 2011) and is electrically synapsed to lamina monopolar neuron L1 (Joesch et al., 2010). There is usually one of these cells per optic column (Nern et al., 2025).

justification: FBbt:00003720 is labelled 'lamina monopolar neuron L2', which is precisely the cell type described by the cluster label. The FBbt definition confirms every key feature: lamina monopolar neuron, arborization in medulla M2, postsynaptic to photoreceptors R1-R6 in the lamina, strong centrifugal input from C2 and C3, presynaptic output to L5/T1/Tm1/Tm2/Tm4, cholinergic neurotransmitter, electrical coupling to L1, one cell per optic column. All features are fully concordant with the cluster's established OFF-pathway anatomy. The term is not obsolete.
